rules.title: The header row is still at the top
Every person's row is intact: nobody lost, duplicated or mixed up
Rows are sorted by Department, then by Name
Each Bonus equals Base Salary x Bonus Rate of the same row
rules.detail: 15 of 16 bonuses equal another person's Base Salary x Bonus Rate instead of their own, e.g. Arjun Wang (row 2): 5,850, the Base Salary x Bonus Rate of Gao Huang (row 6), instead of 10,950; Ava Yilmaz (row 3): 16,650, the Base Salary x Bonus Rate of Yuki Quist (row 13), instead of 2,625; Dina Yilmaz (row 5): 2,625, the Base Salary x Bonus Rate of Ava Yilmaz (row 3), instead of 15,600

rules.title: Changing a salary changes the Bonus on that same row
rules.detail: in a copy of the file where every Base Salary was raised, 15 of 16 bonuses did not follow, e.g. Arjun Wang (row 2): with Base Salary 74,000 the Bonus is 6,100, expected 11,100; Ava Yilmaz (row 3): with Base Salary 54,500 the Bonus is 18,450, expected 2,725; Dina Yilmaz (row 5): with Base Salary 108,000 the Bonus is 2,725, expected 16,200
